name: headroom
tagline: Compress tool output, logs, and files before they ever reach the LLM
description: headroom is a context compression layer for AI agents that shrinks tool output, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they are sent to the model — cutting tokens by 60–95% while preserving the answer. It ships as a library, a proxy, and an MCP server, with six algorithms (including SmartCrusher, CodeCompressor, and Kompress-base) plus reversible compression (CCR) so originals are never destroyed. headroom works across agents — Claude, Codex, Gemini — and its headroom learn command writes corrections back into CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, so agent memory improves with usage. Benchmarks show 92% token savings on SRE debugging.
highlights: Cuts tokens 60–95% on tool output, logs, files, and RAG chunks with equal answers
Six compression algorithms including SmartCrusher, CodeCompressor, and Kompress-base
Reversible compression (CCR) so original data is never lost
Works across Claude, Codex, and Gemini with library, proxy, and MCP server modes
headroom learn persists corrections into CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md for improving agent memory
curatorNote: Token budgets are the real constraint of the agent era, and headroom attacks it at the right place — before the payload reaches the model. Reversible compression and a learn command that writes back into agent memory make this far more than a dumb compressor.
